<DESCRIPTION>
Extends the existing alternating-pattern response to also exploit non-constant three-round periodic opponents, while retaining cooperation initially and last-action matching for responsive opponents.
</DESCRIPTION>

def policy(own_history, opponent_history):

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
